fact: Car 18 left the pit lane during the reconnaissance laps without performing a practice start, but did not cross the white line at pit exit.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. When Car 18 left the pit lane during the reconnaissance laps without performing a practice start, the Car did not cross the white line at pit exit and therefore did not comply with the requirement set out in item 6.5 of the Race Director's Competition Notes.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
